## bkit npm Package extraction — BAR-111 (2026-05-04)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `docs/plans/202605/bar-111-bkit-npm-package-plan.md` (master, trimmed manual runbook), `docs/plans/202605/bar-111-bkit-npm-package-plan-{1,2,3}.md` (split sub-plans — A producer, B consumer migration, C smoke; only A executed in this repo, B and C remain in `app-gether-life`).
- **Summary:** Extracted canonical `.agents/` payload from `app-gether-life` into standalone `bkit` repo. Implemented three CLI verbs (`init`, `install`, `check` — no `upgrade`, folded into install). `install` runs three passes: payload (mirrors `<pkg>/.agents/{workflows,prompts,templates}/` into consumer's `.agents/`), host (regen `.{claude,cursor}/{commands,agents}/` with T1/T2/T3 transforms), templates (managed-block updates per case 1/2/3a/3b). bkit-prefix ownership rule: bkit owns `bkit-*` files in six bkit-managed dirs; non-prefixed files are project-managed and never touched. Distributed as a **git dependency from a private GitHub repo** (`pnpm add -D github:cbartens/bkit#v0.1.1` + `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` allowlist), not via npm registry — public scope `@bartens` was unpublished and renamed to `@cbartens` (matches GitHub identity). 63 vitest tests passing; consumer smoke verified end-to-end in `www-visitfrasercoast-com` against both `#v0.1.0` and `#v0.1.1` — `init`, idempotent re-`install`, and `check` all green.
- **Related:** BAR-111, https://github.com/cbartens/bkit/releases/tag/v0.1.1, tag `v0.1.1` (commit `da1bdee`), tag `v0.1.0` (commit `fb34d28`). Sub-plans B (consumer migration) and C (second-repo smoke) are owned by `app-gether-life` and remain open in that repo's `docs/plans/drafts/`.

## bkit CI hotfix — drop dual pnpm SoT (KN-3) — BAR-130 (2026-05-05)

- **Category:** infra
- **Artifacts:** `docs/plans/202605/logs/bar-130-ci-lint-scaffolding/debug-summary.md`, `docs/plans/202605/logs/bar-130-ci-lint-scaffolding/debug-failure-diagnose-1.md`, `docs/plans/202605/logs/bar-130-ci-lint-scaffolding/debug-failure-remediate-1.md`. Hotfix branch `fix/bar-130-ci-pnpm` (cut from `origin/dev` after squash-merge made original feat branch unrebaseable).
- **Summary:** Second ship cycle for BAR-130. Post-merge dev CI run [25354307730](https://github.com/cbartens/bkit/actions/runs/25354307730) on commit `8646711` failed at `Setup pnpm` with `Error: Multiple versions of pnpm specified` — pnpm/action-setup@v4 enforces single-SoT and aborted because both `with: version: 10` (workflow YAML) and `pnpm@10.33.0` (`package.json#packageManager`) were declared. Same defect existed in `.agents/templates/.github/workflows/ci.yml` with `version: {{PNPM_VERSION}}` — would have shipped to every consumer running `bkit install --ci`. **Fix:** dropped `with: version:` block from both ci.yml files (bkit-self + consumer template); `package.json#packageManager` becomes the single SoT (Corepack-aware). Added KN-3 warning comments inline in both files. Annotated `bkit-tokens.ts` `resolvePnpmVersion` (kept for interface stability; retired in v0.2 per pending entry — `{{PNPM_VERSION}}` token is now dead code). Two regex-based regression guards added to `bkit-modules.integration.test.ts` (lines 534–557) asserting neither ci.yml sets `with.version:` for `pnpm/action-setup@v4`. Pre-existing `toContain("10")` assertion updated (broken by template token removal). 175 tests pass; typecheck + format:check + slop-scan + lint:prose green. No version bump (still v0.1.2).
- **Related:** BAR-130, KN-3 (single-SoT rule), run 25354307730, `docs/pending.md` v0.2 `{{PNPM_VERSION}}` retire entry, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.agents/templates/.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-tokens.ts`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-modules.integration.test.ts`.

## bkit install preflight + post-install AI checklist — BAR-141 (2026-05-06)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `docs/plans/202605/bar-141-preflight-checklist-plan.md`. Logs: `docs/plans/202605/logs/bar-141-preflight-checklist/` (build-summary, build-plan-execute-1-log, build-challenge, build-challenge-tests, build-plan-verify-1-1, ship-update-docs). PR #5 (squash-merged to `dev` 2026-05-06).
- **Summary:** Replaced bkit's ad-hoc `printSink: string[]` advisory channel with a structured `PreflightFinding[]` accumulator; split install into **three phases**: Phase 1 preflight (read-only, blockers short-circuit before any writes), Phase 2 dispatch (unchanged), Phase 3 post-install re-detection (token surfaces, ci.yml env, vale sync, devDeps fetch). **New files:** `.agents/scripts/bkit-preflight.ts` (3 blocker detectors — `detectNoPackageJson`, `detectMalformedPackageJson`, `detectNotGitRepo`; 6 advisory detectors — `detectHuskyNoMarkers`, `detectPrettierignoreNoMarkers`, `detectLintProseF9Vulnerable`, `detectBkitVersionMajorDowngrade`, `detectBkitVersionPinStale`, `detectHooksConfigOverwriteRisk`); `.agents/scripts/bkit-postinstall.ts` (4 token-surface detectors — `detectShellToken`, `detectNpmrcAuth`, `detectGhSecret`, `detectVercelEnv`; 3 other detectors — `detectCiYmlMissingTokenEnv`, `detectValePackageNotSynced`, `detectDevDepsNeedFetch`; `formatChecklist` renderer). **Migrations:** `ModuleContext.printSink: string[]` → `advisories: PreflightFinding[]` (15+ call sites in `bkit-modules.ts` + `bkit-tiers.ts`); deleted `GH_BKIT_TOKEN_INSTALL_MISSING/UNKNOWN_INSTRUCTIONS` and `VERCEL_AUTH_INSTRUCTIONS` constants (verbatim text moved to Phase 3 detector `action` fields); moved `checkBkitTokenSecret` and `detectVercelProject` from `bkit-modules.ts` to `bkit-postinstall.ts`. **Dedup:** intra-phase first-occurrence-wins in both `runPreflight` and `runPostInstallCheck`; cross-phase Phase 3 wins. **Dry-run parity:** `bkit check` skips Phase 3 but still renders Phase 1 advisories via `formatChecklist(ctx.advisories)` (KN-4). **Build challenge** surfaced 5 MEDIUM findings — all remediated pre-merge: NaN guard on empty `.bkit-version` reads (KN-5), shell-injection hardening via `execFileSync` over `execSync` (KN-6), regex-based ci.yml env detection, intra-phase dedup test coverage, exported `dedupeById` helper. **Debug cycle** caught dist/ staleness (KN-7) — `pnpm build` was missing from pre-push hook, CI's "Verify dist/ is fresh" step caught it on commit `edbd891`; fix `7ab6bff` regenerated dist. **Tests:** 371 pass (14 files): `bkit-preflight.test.ts` (30 unit), `bkit-postinstall.test.ts` (38 unit), `bkit-challenge-tests.test.ts` (21 challenge edge cases), `bkit-install.integration.test.ts` (3 scenarios — blocker exit 1, advisory checklist, dry-run parity). **Critical safety addition:** `detectHooksConfigOverwriteRisk` blocker (KN-8) — preflight exits 1 when `.cursor/hooks.json` or `.claude/settings.json` contain non-default content (consumer extensions), preventing Tier-1 full-overwrite from destroying consumer hook blocks (regression observed on `app-gether-life`).
- **Related:** BAR-141, PR #5, DE-4 (PreflightFinding ADR), KN-4 (Phase 3 install-only), KN-5 (parseInt NaN guard), KN-6 (execFileSync over execSync), KN-7 (dist/ staleness), KN-8 (Tier-1 unsafe for consumer-extensible config), `docs/pending.md` `bkit doctor verb` entry, commits `edbd891` (broke dist/), `7ab6bff` (fixed dist/), `.agents/scripts/bkit-preflight.ts`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-postinstall.ts`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-install.ts`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-modules.ts`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-tiers.ts`, `README.md` (`## Install lifecycle` section).

NO `BLOCK`/`WARN` terminology (canonical challenge ladder only). `bkit-build.md` Steps 9–18 wired: Step 9 launches both challenges in parallel, NEW Step 10 reconciles, former Steps 10–17 renumbered to 11–18; `CHALLENGE_VERDICT` extraction moved from old Step 9 → new Step 10; `CHALLENGE_REMEDIATE_ATTEMPT` counter persists across `Re-run Step 9` re-entries (NOT reset). **Fix 5:** `bkit-ship.md` Step 2 bare `git rebase origin/dev || exit 1` → sentinel-file Failure Path routing (`if ! git rebase ...; then git rebase --abort; touch {FID}/.rebase-failed; fi` inside the same bash block; prose sub-step 3a checks sentinel; Failure Path Step 4 condition broadened to include sentinel presence so `bkit-debug-abort-handover` fires for rebase aborts). `REBASE_FAILED` env-var pattern explicitly rejected (bash-block scope does not survive across orchestrator boundaries; sentinel file is canonical inter-block signal). ## bkit workflow commit/push reduction — BAR-187 (2026-05-12)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `.bkit/workflows/bkit-{design,plan,build,debug,ship}.md`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-status.ts`, `.bkit/docs/workflows.md` § status.json, KN-21. PR #30.
- **Summary:** Eliminated ~50 commits and ~10 dev pushes per typical workflow run. Two structural changes: (1) **`parentSha` replaces `commitSha`** in `status.json` step entries — `parentSha` is captured at step START (before the step's commit), eliminating the double-commit-per-step that the prior `commitSha` chicken-and-egg required. (2) **`status.json` on `dev` for all five workflows** (BAR-183 had plan/design only; BAR-187 extends to build/debug/ship) — `$REPO_ROOT/docs/plans/202605/logs/{FID}/status.json` is written per-step file-only (uncommitted) and committed + pushed to `dev` exactly once per workflow run at close-workflow (success) OR Failure Path (failure). Per-step commits on `feat/{FID}` are now one per step instead of two. `cat $REPO_ROOT/docs/plans/202605/logs/{FID}/status.json` works from anywhere on the machine without entering the worktree. PR #30 squash-merged; KN-21 appended to `docs/knowledge.md`.
- **Related:** BAR-187, BAR-183, BAR-184, PR #30, KN-21, `.bkit/docs/workflows.md` § status.json, `.agents/scripts/bkit-status.ts`

## bkit PR-base gates + rollback runbook + revert-branch pre-push bypass — BAR-170 (2026-05-12)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `.bkit/workflows/bkit-build.md` Step 17, `.bkit/workflows/bkit-ship.md` Step 2, `docs/deployments.md` § Production rollback runbook, `.husky/pre-push`. PR #32.
- **Summary:** Three hardening items. (1) **PR-base gate**: `/bkit-build` Step 17 and `/bkit-ship` Step 2 both assert `PR_BASE` = `dev` after resolving `PR_NUMBER`; any PR targeting `main` directly routes to Failure Path with `PR base is not dev`. Prevents accidental squash-merge into `main` from the ship workflow. (2) **Production rollback runbook** added to `docs/deployments.md`: one-shot `pnpm rollback:main <green-sha>` script (save branch protection → disable → force-reset ref → restore) + manual playbook when the script doesn't apply + post-rollback verification checklist including Vercel promotion. (3) **Revert-branch pre-push bypass**: `.husky/pre-push` detects `revert-*` branch name or `Revert "…"` HEAD subject and skips `pnpm test`, running only `pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check`. Rationale: rollback source trees are intentionally inconsistent. PR #32 squash-merged.
- **Related:** BAR-170, PR #32, `docs/deployments.md` § Production rollback runbook, `.bkit/workflows/bkit-build.md`, `.bkit/workflows/bkit-ship.md`, `.husky/pre-push`

## bkit tracker pluggability — github/linear/none provider abstraction — #39 (2026-05-22)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `.bkit/docs/trackers.md` (github/linear/none provider definitions + snippet inventory + substitution contract), `.agents/scripts/bkit-trackers.{ts,test.ts}` (parser + substituter + 16 unit tests), `.agents/scripts/bkit-manifest.ts` (`IssueTracker` type + `bkit.issueTracker` field), `.agents/scripts/bkit-cli.ts` (`--tracker=<github|linear|none>` flag), `.agents/scripts/bkit-modules.ts` (substitution wired into mirror passes), `.agents/scripts/bkit-postinstall.ts` + `.agents/scripts/bkit-preflight.ts` (provider-aware advisories), `.bkit/workflows/bkit-{design,plan,build,debug,ship,ci-router}.md` (marker pairs at every tracker call site), `.bkit/docs/workflows.md` § Tracker Substitution + provider-abstract canonical invariants. PR #120, squash SHA `342fce2`.
- **Summary:** Lands the foundational substitution mechanism + workflow rewrite for the Linear→GitHub tracker migration. `.bkit/docs/trackers.md` defines three providers (`github` / `linear` / `none`); workflows carry `<!-- bkit:tracker {id} start --> ... end -->` marker pairs at every tracker call site; `bkit install --tracker=<name>` writes the manifest field, merges `mcpServers.<name>` into `.mcp.json` (+ Cursor variant), and substitutes provider snippets into mirror output (zero markers in `.claude/commands/*` / `.cursor/commands/*`). Substitution counts verified across all 6 workflows × 3 trackers (build 31, design 23, plan 19, ship 21, debug 23, ci-router 9; no missing, no orphans). **Uniform new-comment-per-step semantics** across providers — Linear loses edit-in-place rule for parity with GitHub-MCP capabilities (`mcp__linear__save_comment` and `mcp__github__add_issue_comment` both create new comments per step; no `COMMENT_ID` tracking). **Label vocabulary** rewritten to `bkit:design|plan|build|debug|ship|merged` (phase, mutually exclusive) + `bkit:auto|failed|debug` (additive). **AGENTS.md cross-host router** accepts `#NNN` (GitHub), `[A-Z]+-\d+` (Linear/prefixed), and bare `\d+` (GitHub fallback). **PR body metadata marker** `<!-- bkit:issue=#NNN bkit:fid=NNN-slug bkit:auto -->` written at PR creation; downstream debug/ship/ci-router workflows resolve issue ID via `mcp__github__pull_request_read`. **Marker namespacing**: bkit-emitted commits prepend `bkit ` for attribution (`bkit [skip ci]`, `bkit [verbose ci]` etc.); CHECK sites in `ci.yml` + workflows match bare substring so user-typed markers still trigger. **Out of scope (follow-on)**: CI-router double-gate runtime, Cursor cloud dispatch docs, `BAR-` → `ISSUE-` doc sweep, full dogfood Design→Ship cycle.
- **Related:** #39, PR #120, squash SHA `342fce2`, `.bkit/docs/trackers.md`, `.agents/scripts/bkit-trackers.ts`, `.bkit/docs/workflows.md` § Tracker Substitution + Workflow Authoring Rules, follow-on phases 6 (CI-router double gate) / 10 (Cursor cloud dispatch docs) / 11 (dogfood cycle) per #39 handover comment `4514709114`.

model-ID lookup is documentation, not a verb (`.bkit/providers.md` § Models per-provider live `/v1/models` recipe). **Cloud lane** — `bkit-auto.yml` renamed to a single `bkit-cloud.yml` carrying a claude job (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`-gated, OIDC) AND an opencode job (`OPENCODE_PROVIDER_KEY`-gated, `opencode run` CLI), each runtime-gated on its secret; The four cloud OpenAI-compatible providers were live-probed (`/v1/models`) + tool-call-smoked (a real `tools:` round-trip emitting `tool_calls`) on 2026-06-11 (Phases 1–2). **zen** (Phase 3, 2026-06-12) is a **managed-auth gateway** (opencode provider id `opencode`, models `opencode/<id>`, auth via `opencode auth login` — NOT a `{env:KEY}` block) with a DISTINCT render path: `renderOpencodeJson` emits **no custom provider block**; install persists `bkit.opencodeProvider` to `package.json` (the only upgrade-time detection signal for a block-free gateway — else upgrade re-renders zen as the `ollama-local` default and injects a stray block); `buildOpencodeModelLookup` seeds the opencode-side prefix (never `zen/`); `bkit doctor` reports managed-auth state (parses `opencode auth list`, **excluding the `auth.json` path line** to avoid a false `LOGGED IN`); `bkit status` routes the provider through `detectOpencodeProvider` (also fixing a latent always-"unknown" `cfg.provider.name` read). zen's `Zen` column was curated against the **live** `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` endpoint — **existence-validated** (per-model tool-call smoke deferred to consumer `opencode auth login`, managed auth = bkit holds no key); the probe corrected the docs-only `qwen3.7-plus` → live `qwen3.6-plus` (KN-40). zen tier pins (cross-platform reuse): opus=`opencode/kimi-k2.6`, sonnet=`opencode/qwen3.6-plus`, haiku=`opencode/gemini-3-flash`, convergent=`opencode/deepseek-v4-pro`. **Tests:** 1452 pass (+ zen CLI allowlist, `opencodeProviderId`, `renderOpencodeJson` no-block, `buildOpencodeModelLookup` curated tiers, live install+upgrade round-trip proving manifest-detection keeps zen block-free); slop delta net 0; live `bkit install --opencode=zen` verified (46 agents, 0 placeholders).
- **Related:** #245 (closed), commits `82036ad` (provider keys), `12f4c49` (cloud curated columns), `a348faa` (zen render path), `895ddf2` (zen curated columns), DE-28, KN-40, `.bkit/src/{bkit-cli,bkit-install,bkit-modules}.ts`, `.bkit/{prompts,providers}.md`, `.bkit/.env.example`, `.bkit/README.md`. Supersedes the `gemini` provider named in DE-27 (descoped — realized set is the six named OpenAI-compatible providers + zen).

## v4.0.0 CLI surface redesign — #252/#253 (2026-06-12)

- **Category:** agentic

Dropped flags: `--full`, `--core`, `--ci`, `--lint`, `--git-hooks`, bare `--renovate`/`--dependabot` (use `--dependency=<name>`), `--cloud` (use `--auto=`); `--non-interactive` renamed `--auto-apply`. `CLAUDE.md` ownership moved from `core` to the `--claude` module. Tracker switching freed (no `--force` needed). New `bkit status` read-only verb reports installed hosts + providers. `bkit upgrade` scoped to installed modules only (no phantom re-render of uninstalled modules). 1489 tests green.

## CI-Dispatch Gate — outcome-based verification of the final loud push — #261 (2026-06-16)

- **Category:** agentic
- **Artifacts:** `docs/plans/202606/261-ci-trigger-gate-plan.md`. Logs: `docs/plans/202606/logs/261-ci-trigger-gate/` (build-summary, build-input, build-install-skills, build-plan-execute-1-log, build-plan-verify-1-1, build-challenge{,-1,-2,-remediate-log,-tests}, design/plan artifacts, status.jsonl). PR #276, squash SHA `8ab39dc`.
- **Summary:** Replaced the string-only **HEAD-Subject Assertion** safeguard with an **outcome-based CI-Dispatch gate** that, after a build/debug workflow's final loud push, confirms a `bkit-decide` run was actually dispatched for the exact pushed HEAD — closing the KN-11 vacuously-green-PR gap (PR HEAD carries `[skip ci]` → empty `statusCheckRollup` → fail-fast gates admit an untested PR). The gate polls `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup` (fuzzy `test("decide"; "i")` — decide may be consumer-renamed) every `POLL_INTERVAL_S=10`s up to `POLL_BUDGET_S=60`s (ATTEMPTS=6), logging each iteration with the `[bkit-ci-gate]` prefix; on empty-budget + clean HEAD it self-heals **once** (cap=1) with a clean empty `re-trigger` commit, re-polls, then terminates with a named verdict in a 4-outcome state machine — `dispatched` / `self-healed` / `no-ci` (logged pass — consumer has no CI workflow for the event) / `unresolved` (→ Failure Path). Sub-reason codes `timeout-dirty` / `retrigger-suppressed` / `autoroute-mismatch` / `gh-error` discriminate the `unresolved` paths. Verdict is always written to the per-FID `status.jsonl` `step-done` record via the **additive** `ciDispatch` object (`{outcome, head, attempts, retrigger}` + optional `reason`) — backward-compatible with the #209 FOLD reducer (`del(.type,.workflow)` + merge preserves unknown keys). **Authoring-only:** the gate kernel is appended inline at **2 sites, not 3** — build Step 18 close-workflow, debug Step 10 (PR-mode close-workflow sub-step 3 + LOCAL-mode create-pr sub-step 9); **ship is OUT** (its existing `SQUASH_SHA`-poll gate suffices; adding a self-healer there would mask the #81 Change C "essential tests skipped" backstop). The shared poll-loop kernel is byte-equal across build/debug (delimited by `# --- CI-Dispatch Gate shared kernel ---` comments); only the per-site AUTO_ROUTE sourcing legitimately differs (build re-derives `AUTO_ROUTE_SUFFIX` from `LABELS` in-block; debug reuses the in-block var read from `BKIT_AUTO_ROUTE_FILE` before its `rm` — the `rm` is NOT reordered). **D2 invariant preserved** — the gate fires post-final-push ONLY; `worktree-setup`/`create-pr` commits keep `bkit [skip ci]`; zero new mid-build CI triggers (KN-30/§141 cloud-auto-route concurrency intact). **Two companion edge-case guards:** EC-1 pre-flight (`gh pr list --head … --base dev` at build Step 17 entry → existing open PR → Failure Path with named message + `# TODO(#261-ec1)`; probe error → fall through to blind `gh pr create`, no regression); EC-2 abort-guard (build inline Failure Path + shared `.bkit/workflows.md` § Failure Path step 5 → do NOT push a `[skip ci]` abort commit onto a branch with a live PR; probe error → **inverted safe default** = treat as "PR exists, do NOT push"). `.bkit/workflows.md` § "HEAD-Subject Assertion" renamed to § "CI-Dispatch Gate" (string clause RETAINED inside as the pre-push fast-fail); `docs/deployments.md` § "CI trigger on final workflow push" reframed to the outcome gate; KN-11 fix/Related updated to cite the new gate; DE-32 appended with rejected alternatives (3 sites; whole-gate byte-equality; PR-mode push for EC-1; `PUSH_MODE` no-op). **Build challenge:** 5 findings (1 HIGH, 4 LOW), 0 CRITICAL — F1 (post-push `ciDispatch` never committed remotely) reconciled by **rejecting** the suggested post-gate commit+push as a KN-11 regression (any commit after the loud close-workflow HEAD re-introduces suppression or fires a second run), instead documenting the intentional **local-only** ledger write via inline NOTE comments (outside the byte-equal kernel delimiters) + a doctrine paragraph; F2 (WS-6 test extracted only the first debug kernel) fixed via `extractAllSharedKernelBlocks` loop; F3/F4/F5 accepted/out-of-scope (transient gh-error verdict flip — fails closed, low risk; `***NO_CI***` deny-list gap — pre-existing, bkit never emits it; debug dev/main + LOCAL coverage — outside documented feature-branch scope). **Tests:** new `.bkit/src/bkit-ci-dispatch-gate-alignment.test.ts` — 43 assertions (25 baseline + 18 challenge-remediation regression guards) covering shared-kernel presence + named symbols + 4 outcomes in both files, build↔debug byte-equality on SHARED sub-lines only (build=1 kernel, debug=2 kernels), ship negative assertion, #209 FOLD round-trip (`ciDispatch.outcome`/`head`/`attempts`/`retrigger` survive unchanged), post-gate non-push KN-11 guard, sub-reason→`unresolved`-only mapping, vacuous-match guards; full suite 1553 pass (11 pre-existing parallel-contention flakes unrelated). Mirrors re-rendered once (batched) — all 6 surfaces (build+debug × .claude/.cursor/.opencode) carry the gate. **Open (HUMAN, post-merge):** 5 live boundary dogfood rows (real `gh`/Actions) — happy-path `dispatched`, forced-`[skip ci]` `self-healed`, `no-ci` discriminator, EC-2 HEAD-preserve, EC-1 fail-fast — deferred (require ephemeral branches + live Actions runs; not automatable pre-merge).
- **Related:** #261, PR #276, squash SHA `8ab39dc`, #209 (additive `ciDispatch` on `step-done`), #81 (Change C backstop — why ship is out), #184 (HEAD-Subject Assertion augmented), #279 (squash-body `[skip ci]` leak — same class, NOT fixed here), §141/KN-30 (D2 concurrency constraint), DE-32, KN-11 (vacuously-green PR — gate is now the enforcement mechanism), `.bkit/workflows/bkit-build.md` (Step 18 gate + Step 17 EC-1 + inline Failure-Path EC-2), `.bkit/workflows/bkit-debug.md` (Step 10 PR-mode + LOCAL-mode gates), `.bkit/workflows.md` § "CI-Dispatch Gate" + § Failure Path step 5 EC-2, `.bkit/src/bkit-ci-dispatch-gate-alignment.test.ts`, `docs/deployments.md` § "CI trigger on final workflow push", `.bkit/friction.md`, rendered mirrors `.{claude,cursor,opencode}/commands/bkit-{build,debug}.md`.
